nights.title: Barry Manilow
nights.name: Barry Manilow
nights.extract: Barry Manilow is an American singer, songwriter and record producer with a career spanning over 60 years. His hit recordings include "Mandy", "Could It Be Magic", "I Write the Songs", "Weekend in New England", "Looks Like We Made It", "Can't Smile Without You", "Copacabana ", and "Ready to Take a Chance Again".

nights.title: Mon Laferte - Femme Fatale Tour
nights.name: Mon Laferte
nights.extract: Norma Montserrat Bustamante Laferte, known professionally as Mon Laferte, is a Chilean and Mexican singer-songwriter. Recognized for her versatility, her musical style spans a wide array of genres, including pop, alternative, bolero, cumbia, and salsa. She rose to international prominence in the 2010s, particularly for her melodramatic vocals and theatrical stage presence. In 2025, Billboard named her one of the greatest female Latin pop artists of all time.

nights.title: Metallica - Suite Reservation
nights.name: Metallica
nights.extract: Metallica is an American heavy metal band. It was formed in Los Angeles in 1981 by vocalist/guitarist James Hetfield and drummer Lars Ulrich, and has been based in San Francisco for most of its career. The band's fast tempos, instrumentals and aggressive musicianship made them one of the founding "big four" bands of thrash metal, alongside Megadeth, Anthrax and Slayer. Metallica's current lineup comprises founding members and primary songwriters Hetfield and Ulrich, longtime lead guitarist Kirk Hammett and bassist Robert Trujillo. en.kicker: American heavy metal band · formed in Los Angeles in 1981
en.who: Metallica is an American heavy metal band. It was formed in Los Angeles in 1981 by vocalist/guitarist James Hetfield and drummer Lars Ulrich, and has been based in San Francisco for most of its career. Its current lineup comprises Hetfield, Ulrich, Kirk Hammett and Robert Trujillo.

de.who: Metallica ist eine amerikanische Heavy-Metal-Band. Sie wurde 1981 in Los Angeles von Sänger und Gitarrist James Hetfield und Schlagzeuger Lars Ulrich gegründet und war den größten Teil ihrer Laufbahn in San Francisco ansässig. Zur aktuellen Besetzung gehören Hetfield, Ulrich, Kirk Hammett und Robert Trujillo.
facts: Mit ihren schnellen Tempi, ihren Instrumentalpassagen und ihrer aggressiven Spielweise zählt die Band zu den Gründungsbands der "Big Four" des Thrash Metal, neben Megadeth, Anthrax und Slayer.
Der frühere Gitarrist Dave Mustaine gründete Megadeth, nachdem er 1983 bei Metallica gefeuert worden war.

tr.kicker: Amerikalı heavy metal grubu · 1981, Los Angeles
tr.who: Metallica, Amerikalı bir heavy metal grubudur. Grup, 1981'de Los Angeles'ta vokalist/gitarist James Hetfield ve davulcu Lars Ulrich tarafından kuruldu ve kariyerinin büyük bölümünde San Francisco'yu merkez üssü olarak kullandı. Güncel kadroda Hetfield, Ulrich, Kirk Hammett ve Robert Trujillo yer alıyor.
facts: Hızlı tempoları, enstrümantal bölümleri ve agresif çalgıcılığıyla grup, Megadeth, Anthrax ve Slayer ile birlikte thrash metalin kurucu "big four" gruplarından biri oldu.
Eski üyelerden Dave Mustaine, 1983'te Metallica'dan kovulduktan sonra Megadeth'i kurdu.
